themes.title: Right-wing leaders criticize abortion and feminist policies
themes.blurb: Across multiple countries, right-wing leaders are intensifying their rhetoric against abortion and feminist movements, framing them as detrimental to national values and economic stability. This theme reflects a coordinated push to roll back reproductive rights and challenge gender equality initiatives, often linking these policies to broader cultural and demographic concerns.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei blamed abortion and feminist policies for Argentina's declining birth rate, calling them 'the madness of the green handkerchiefs' and linking them to economic and pension system strains.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Giorgia Meloni criticized feminist movements for focusing on trivial issues like gendered language, arguing that true equality is not about titles but leadership and freedom.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Polish President Karol Nawrocki proposed strict penalties for medical practitioners who discourage evidence-based treatments, targeting alternative medicine but also intersecting with feminist health advocacy.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox has consistently opposed feminist policies, including abortion rights, and has criticized Spain's government for supporting feminist movements, framing them as part of a broader cultural decline.

themes.title: Right-wing parties push anti-immigration policies amid border crises
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe and the Americas are escalating their anti-immigration rhetoric and policies, often in response to perceived border crises. This theme highlights a transnational pattern of securitizing migration, blaming governments for inaction, and demanding stricter controls, deportations, and even the suspension of international agreements like Schengen.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Giorgia Meloni defended Italy's strict migration policies, citing the EU's new Migration and Asylum Pact as a positive shift for Italy. She also faced criticism for suspending Schengen with Spain, which led to other EU countries resuming migrant transfers to Italy.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox has intensified its anti-immigration stance, demanding immediate deportations of migrants in Ceuta and accusing the Spanish government of enabling human trafficking. The party has also criticized the government for housing migrant minors while neglecting elderly care.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK has pushed for stricter immigration controls, including ending benefits for illegal immigrants and reducing legal migration. The party has also criticized the government for failing to address small boat crossings and has proposed policies to deter asylum seekers.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: The Trump administration has escalated its anti-immigration policies, including expanding deportations to third countries, imposing new sanctions on Cuba, and proposing stricter asylum rules. Trump has also threatened economic consequences for countries aiding Iran, framing it as part of a broader immigration and security strategy.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen and Jordan Bardella have proposed ending free healthcare for undocumented immigrants and tightening France's immigration policies. The party has also criticized the government for failing to address migration-related security concerns.

themes.title: Far-right parties gain ground in regional and national elections
themes.blurb: Far-right and right-wing parties are making significant electoral gains across Europe, often capitalizing on voter dissatisfaction with mainstream parties. This theme reflects a broader trend of far-right parties securing more seats in regional and national legislatures, sometimes even leading in polls ahead of key elections.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: The AfD is leading in polls for the upcoming Saxony-Anhalt state election, with projections suggesting it could win up to 30% of the vote. The party is also gaining traction in other eastern German states, challenging the political establishment.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: The Sweden Democrats continue to gain support, with leader Jimmie Åkesson campaigning on issues like rural development, lower taxes, and stricter immigration policies. The party is positioning itself as a kingmaker in Sweden's political landscape.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK has made electoral gains in local by-elections, including winning a council seat in Cumberland. The party is also challenging the Conservative Party in key constituencies, positioning itself as a viable alternative for disaffected voters.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: The RN is leading in polls for the 2027 French presidential election, with Marine Le Pen and Jordan Bardella positioning the party as a strong contender. The RN has also made gains in local elections and is pushing for a constitutional referendum on immigration.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: The Progress Party is gaining traction in Norway, with local branches pushing for privatization and deregulation. The party is also positioning itself as a key player in Norway's political landscape, advocating for reduced immigration and lower taxes.

themes.title: Right-wing governments target social programs amid fiscal debates
themes.blurb: Right-wing governments are increasingly targeting social programs for cuts or reforms, often framing these measures as necessary for fiscal responsibility. This theme highlights a transnational pattern of austerity, deregulation, and privatization, with leaders justifying these policies as essential for economic recovery and growth.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's government has implemented severe austerity measures, including cuts to social programs, deregulation, and privatization. Milei has framed these policies as necessary to reduce inflation and restore economic growth, despite widespread public opposition.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: The Trump administration has proposed cuts to social programs, including SNAP benefits, Head Start, and healthcare subsidies. The administration has also pushed for deregulation and privatization, particularly in sectors like education and healthcare.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK has proposed significant cuts to social programs, including a £21 billion reduction in Personal Independence Payments (PIP) and stricter eligibility criteria for welfare benefits. The party has also advocated for deregulation and privatization in sectors like healthcare and education.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: The Tisza government has implemented austerity measures, including cuts to public sector salaries and social programs. The government has also pushed for deregulation and privatization, particularly in sectors like energy and infrastructure.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox has criticized Spain's social welfare system, advocating for stricter eligibility criteria and reduced spending on programs like healthcare and education. The party has also pushed for deregulation and privatization, particularly in sectors like energy and transportation.

themes.title: Right-wing leaders face internal party divisions and leadership challenges
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across multiple countries are grappling with internal divisions and leadership challenges, often driven by ideological differences, electoral setbacks, or personal rivalries. This theme reflects a broader pattern of instability within right-wing movements, with factions pushing for changes in leadership or direction.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Matteo Salvini is facing internal challenges from northern governors and party leaders who are pushing for a more federalist and less right-wing direction. The party is also grappling with declining poll numbers and calls for a leadership overhaul.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's government is facing internal divisions, particularly between his sister Karina Milei and other key figures like Santiago Caputo. The party is also grappling with public opposition to its economic policies and a potential split in Buenos Aires.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS is experiencing a major split, with former Prime Minister Mateusz Morawiecki forming a new faction called Rozwój Plus. The party is also facing internal divisions over its relationship with President Karol Nawrocki and its electoral strategy.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK is facing internal challenges, including the resignation of a councillor over controversial social media posts and criticism of its leadership. The party is also grappling with electoral setbacks and calls for a more unified strategy.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: The Tisza government is facing internal challenges, including the resignation of János Lázár and criticism of its economic policies. The party is also grappling with public dissatisfaction and calls for greater transparency.
